test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: ‘Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar’ is given by which of the following bodies?
solution:
the correct answer is __**Sangeet Natak Akademi**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Sangeet Natak Akademi (The National Academy of Music, Dance, and Drama in English) is **the national-level academy for performing arts set up by the Government of India**.
 
• Ustad Bismillah Khan Yuva Puraskar (Akademi Award) is **an award given by the Sangeet Natak Akademi to outstanding artists under 40 who have demonstrated talent in the fields of music, dance, and Theatre**
 
• Award winners receive a prize of Rs 25000 (US$350) from the chairman of** ****Sangeet Natak Akademi** in a special ceremony.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vishnu Digambar Paluskar** and the **Gandharva Mahavidyalaya** were established by him in** 1901 at Lahore**.
 
• The** Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan** is a composite institution spreading out into diverse fields of Indian cultural life.
 
• The Bhavan is not an institution but a movement seeking to reintegrate Indian Culture, by the application of the modern critical apparatus to its ancient heritage. 
 
• **National School of Drama** it was set up by the** Sangeet Natak Akademi **as one of its constituent units in **1959**.
